effects.description: A burst saves only its latest text after 120 ms.
A later burst remains live after the first batch completes.
Close preserves pending text once without a retired badge update.
Switch preserves A under A's key and keeps B independent.
Reopening the same key restores committed text without an old timer.
Preview publishes once at 40 ms or the authorized 120 ms.
Reuse publishes only the fresh query.
Preview delay and lifecycle form one coherent policy.
Preview delay changed to 120 ms, requiring authorization.
